content: OPA (Rego) and Casbin are general-purpose policy/access-control engines aimed at multi-service, multi-role authorization surfaces (microservices, K8s, RBAC/ABAC with many subjects and resources). Both add a DSL or policy-file layer and, for OPA, typically a sidecar/service to evaluate policy. For a small, fixed set of scopes enforced within a single application's own SQL queries, community guidance treats plain SQL WHERE-clause / application-level checks as sufficient and the policy-engine layer as added complexity that pays off only as scope/role count and cross-service reuse grow.
